Pe, peh, fe, feh: the seventeenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet, after ע and before צ.
Used alone (in normal, not final form) to mark the end of a petuhah.
Samekh, samech: the fifteenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet, after נ and before ע.
Used to mark the end of a setumah.
